findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "shoot_plan_draft_next" stacks urgency/override words (never, ignore). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "shoot-plan" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shoot_plan_allowance · Private data: shoot_plan_quote, shoot_plan_list, shoot_plan_progress_sync, shoot_plan_shot_list, shoot_plan_export_for_generation, shoot_plan_draft_gate, shoot_plan_validate_takes, shoot_plan_edit_guide, shoot_plan_export_edit, shoot_plan_call_sheet, shoot_plan_shoot_pack, shoot_plan_summary, shoot_plan_diff, shoot_plan_record_decision, shoot_plan_to_dpl, shoot_plan_allowance · Public sink: shoot_plan_quote, shoot_plan_draft_start, shoot_plan_draft_next, shoot_plan_draft_gate, shoot_plan_merge_takes, shoot_plan_slice, shoot_plan_diff, shoot_plan_record_decision · Destructive: shoot_plan_format, shoot_plan_shot_list, shoot_plan_export_for_generation, shoot_plan_draft_next, shoot_plan_draft_gate, shoot_plan_export_edit, shoot_plan_summary, shoot_plan_allowance.
